messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert fired — p99 latency breach (eu-west inference cluster). threshold=1500ms, current=p99 2.3s, duration=3m. PagerDuty PD-47612. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/eu/p99
maya: acked. I'm oncall for this window, will take lead.
rafael: looking. which model/route? any obvious error spike?
incident-bot: Affected routes: /v1/generate (model: rwd-base-v2), traffic spike + KV-cache eviction rate increased. stack traces: none. Log tail: https://logs.redwood/streams/PD-47612
maya: quick check: backend queue depth up on sidecar batcher, evictions spiking on kv-cache-3. p95 mostly ok, tail only.
paula: suggestion — enable fallback routing to dedicated-small for heavy token requests. also consider temporary per-route throttle.
kevin: scaling up gpu-pool eu-west-12 by +2 nodes now. cmd: kubectl scale deployment inference-eu-west --replicas=8 -n infra (started).
maya: rolling a 5% traffic shift to us-west fallback group (policy id: fallback-2026-03). cmd: POST /api/v1/route/shift {"route":"/v1/generate","percent":5,"target":"us-west"}
lynn: customer impact? are we dropping requests or just slow?
maya: mostly slow responses, a few timeouts for very long generations. early impact: ~12 customers with elevated p99; highest is Statlify (enterprise) showing 10% error rate on long outputs.
sre-runbook-bot: Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/latency-p99. Steps recommended: 1) enable fallback routing 2) throttle long-tail routes 3) scale pool 4) monitor KV cache eviction.
paula: I'll toggle per-route throttle now for long-generations. patch: {"route":"/v1/generate","max_output_tokens":1024}.
kevin: gpu pool scaled, pods ready in ~40s. monitoring GPU mem and throughput.
maya: seeing p99 drop to ~1.1s after shift+scale, eviction rate reduced. still watching for secondary bumps.
rafael: good work. I'll stay until cleared or handed off. if p99 > 1.5s for 10m escalate to infra on-call.
maya: plan to handoff at 1766012600 (23:50 UTC) to Rafael. leaving notes: applied 5% shift, scaled pool, throttled long outputs, monitoring Grafana and PD.
rafael: acked. will keep watch and notify if PD escalates.
paula: :thumbsup:
incident-bot: update — alert state changed to "mitigated" (p99 1.05s). PD-47612 status: acknowledged -> mitigated.
incident-bot: resolved — closing alert after 8m stable under threshold. final p99 0.98s. PD-47612 closed.
